info.title: Trojan Compass shared mobile and web API
info.description: Proposed integration contract, prepared 2026-11-14. The supplied repository implements only GET /api/health. This document defines the planned shared Node/Express API for web and Swift clients. No accounts, campus-code fields or public editing APIs. All examples are synthetic contract fixtures. .example hosts do not resolve and no model asset is supplied. Dataset fields are standardized as dataVersion; earlier mapVersionId examples are superseded.

get.description:
Returns supported directory entries and coverage. Trim q; match canonical code, name and aliases case-insensitively. An omitted or empty q lists the directory, ordered by code; nonempty search ranks exact code, prefix, alias, then contains, with ID as tie-breaker. Unknown search text returns 200 with no items.

A directory record may have interiorScene=false. Do not substitute a different building.
Preserve the Medicine Crow to VKC alias while that canonical dataset ID is retained.

get.description:
Filter the selected building's places by q, floorId and kind. Empty q lists matching places, ordered by floor sortOrder and displayLabel. Nonempty q prioritizes exact normalized room/code matches, prefix and aliases. A known building with no matches returns an empty collection.

Wire place kinds are canonical API values; adapt old web values such as room/toilet/emergency-exit explicitly.
A missing mesh key does not make a place nonexistent; position-based marking can still be shown.

get.description:
Global autocomplete over known places. Normalize case, spaces and hyphens. Empty q returns 200 with no items. Optional buildingId/floorId restrict scope; floorId requires buildingId. Rank exact, prefix, alias and contains results with stable ID tie-breakers. A true stepFree filter includes only places proven reachable from a documented verified step-free reference entrance in that building.

A result's reference-entrance reachability does not guarantee a route from the student's actual origin.
Do not dismiss the search panel on result selection.
Discard late responses to older queries; preserve the current query on network failure.

parameters.name: dataVersion
parameters.description: Pin the immutable dataset snapshot. Omit only when discovering the current snapshot; reuse the returned version for dependent requests.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Trimmed search text, maximum 200 characters.

parameters.name: buildingId
parameters.description: Optional building scope.

parameters.name: floorId
parameters.description: Optional floor scope; requires buildingId.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Filter by canonical place kind.

parameters.name: stepFree
parameters.description: Default false. True requires verified reference-entrance reachability, returned in stepFreeEvaluation.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results; default 20, maximum 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation cursor bound to the same filters and dataVersion.

parameters.description: Optional correlation identifier.

parameters.description: Optional cached ETag for the identical version, URL and filters.

post.description:
Validate the snapshot and both structured endpoints, normalize places to usable access points and positions to reachable walkable geometry, then calculate a deterministic route. Same-place returns a zero-length arrival route. Enforce access restrictions and explicit step-free evidence throughout. Return full geometry and steps inline. Missing outdoor topology is a 422 outcome, never a fabricated campus line.

ClientRequestId is echoed for stale-result detection; it is not an idempotency guarantee.
stairs + stepFree=true is a 400 constraint conflict. elevator excludes stairs but alone is not verified step-free access.
Use NO_ROUTE, UNVERIFIED_ACCESSIBILITY, INVALID_POSITION or OUTDOOR_NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE as appropriate for 422.
Do not automatically retry a POST after an ambiguous transport failure.

post.description:
The server interprets text (and optional image input), resolves real dataset identifiers, calls search/routing services and returns validated actions. Bounded client-supplied history is conversation context, not trusted facts. Missing origin or ambiguity produces clarification. No chat persistence or account is required.

Text uses application/json. Optional images use multipart/form-data with request as an application/json part and image as one image/jpeg or image/png part.
Image capability remains false until implemented. Return 501 IMAGE_INPUT_DISABLED when an image arrives while disabled.
200 statuses include resolved, needs_clarification, not_found, no_route and unsupported. Provider failures use 503/504, not a fabricated resolved answer.
Only resolved actions execute. Validate the whole batch and load required scene data before committing UI state.

get.description:
Optional extension. Filter by buildingId, kind and UTC interval. from is inclusive, to exclusive; both must be provided together, with from < to. Omitted interval means the next seven days from server time. Sort by startsAt then ID. Only actual timestamped events with valid destinations are exposed.

Do not invent dates from the existing display-only sample times.
Cancelled events remain identifiable with status cancelled. Hide or disable navigation to invalid destinations.

Id.description: Opaque canonical identifier. Do not parse the building, floor or room from this string.

DataVersion.description: Immutable dataset snapshot ID covering the buildings used by a request.

x.description: X in building-local meters; Y is vertical.

y.description: Y in building-local meters; Y is vertical.

z.description: Z in building-local meters; Y is vertical.

Bounds3.description: Componentwise min must be <= max. A domain validator enforces ordering.

Capabilities.description: Availability for this deployment/building and snapshot. True navigation can be demo navigation; provenance determines the displayed qualification.

Floor.description: Floor IDs are scoped to a building. The current basement is ID 0 with label B. Use sortOrder, not lexicographic ID ordering.

anyOf.description: Explicit ramp evidence. Never infer this from step-free access.

PlaceSearchResult.description: Global autocomplete can return a reference step-free entrance evaluation. The actual origin-to-destination route is checked separately.

Asset.description: Absolute asset URL. Null checksum/length means unavailable in the proposal fixture, not an implemented export.

NodeBinding.description: Exporter-enforced unique nodeName; uniqueness is our asset convention, not guaranteed by glTF.

ProceduralScene.description: Per-floor geometry is already prepared by the backend. Render the supplied boxes/triangle meshes rather than running the web layout generator in Swift.

ModelScene.description: The 4x4 matrix is column-major and applied exactly once to asset-local coordinates. API place/route positions are already in building coordinates.

BoxObject.description: Center is absolute in the building frame. Size is in meters. Rotate about the center around +Y; no parent elevation is added again.

MeshObject.description: Vertices are absolute building-frame positions. Triangle indices occur in triples and must be in range, with counterclockwise front faces. If supplied, normals match vertex count. Domain validators enforce these constraints.

FloorGeometry.description: Server-supplied visual geometry. Client may compute GPU buffers, normals, label layout and picking acceleration. Business geometry/room placement stays server-owned.

PositionLocation.description: Indoor position in the canonical building frame. The server validates membership and reachable snapping; a nearest-node line through a wall is not permitted.

ResolvedEndpoint.description: Preserves the original selection and supplies the normalized route anchor.

via.description: Optional intermediate stop. Both legs must satisfy the same routing preferences.

RouteRequest.description: mode=elevator excludes stair connectors. stepFree=true additionally requires verified usable segments and entrances. stairs+stepFree is invalid.

IndoorLeg.description: One floor only. A same-place arrival may have one point and zero metrics.

VerticalLeg.description: A connection between floors. Keep this separate from horizontal legs so floor-specific drawing and exploded-view transforms remain explicit.

RouteStep.description: pointIndex addresses the referenced leg's points array. Follow this anchor when selecting a step.

via.description: Intermediate stop preserved for reopening or sharing this trip.

Route.description: Complete inline route: no GET /routes/{id} is required. A route ID is a correlation ID, not an indoor tracking session.

ChatContext.description: UI context is supplied by the client and validated by the server. A selected destination is not automatically the user's current position.

image.description: Optional feature: exactly one JPEG or PNG, <= 5 MiB, <= 4096 px per side and <= 16 million decoded pixels. A request without message uses the server's image-location interpretation instruction.

ChatResponse.description: 200 represents a completed conversational turn, including clarification or no_route. A provider failure is an HTTP error. Only validated resolved actions may alter the viewer.

Event.description: Only events with actual dates and validated destinations are exposed. Supplied examples are invented fixtures, not USC event listings.

FloorResponse.description: Procedural scenes return geometry; model scenes may return null geometry when their asset provides it. Places remain available in both cases.
